notes: New: Sabotrack, the lounge's whodunit game! Walk into the Great Hall and press the Sabotrack button (4+ logged-in players). Crew do minigame tasks around the lounge while hidden saboteurs kill, cut the lights, start a meltdown, lock gates and sneak through portals. Report bodies or hit the emergency button to vote people out. During a game the Studio desk becomes a CCTV monitor, and ghosts chat only with other ghosts (everyone sees it after the game). Game chat goes to the new 🎮 Sabotrack room. Also: people who leave SaiDeck in a background tab no longer keep a yellow ring.
